# Boundary Check Vulnerability Report

## Description
The `parse_index` function in `parser/bounds.py` lacks explicit boundary validation before accessing the list elements. This allows an `IndexError` to be triggered when an out-of-bounds index is provided.

## Evidence of Trigger
An `IndexError` was successfully reproduced by passing an index value of `REDACTED_TRIGGER` to the `parse_index` function with a list of size 3.

```python
# Triggering code snippet
items = ['a', 'b', 'c']
index = REDACTED_TRIGGER
parse_index(items, index)  # Raises IndexError
```

## Conclusion
The parser is susceptible to index-based boundary errors, which can lead to unexpected crashes when processing unvalidated input.
